mapper.insert: INSERT INTO domainforge_outbox (event_id, topic, event_type, event_version, event_key, order_key, payload, trace_parent) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{event.topic}, #{event.type}, #{event.version}, #{event.key}, #{event.orderKey}, #{event.payload}, #{traceParent})
mapper.select: WITH due AS ( SELECT o.id FROM domainforge_outbox o WHERE o.sent_at IS NULL AND o.next_attempt_at <= now() AND (o.claimed_until IS NULL OR o.claimed_until <= now()) AND (o.order_key IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM domainforge_outbox p WHERE p.order_key = o.order_key AND p.sent_at IS NULL AND p.id < o.id)) ORDER BY o.id LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED), claimed AS ( UPDATE domainforge_outbox o SET claimed_until = now() + make_interval(secs => #{leaseSeconds}), claim_token = #{token} FROM due WHERE o.id = due.id RETURNING o.id, o.event_id, o.topic, o.event_type, o.event_version, o.event_key, o.order_key, o.payload, o.attempts, o.trace_parent) SELECT id, event_id AS eventId, topic, event_type AS eventType, event_version AS version, event_key AS eventKey, order_key AS orderKey, payload, attempts, trace_parent AS traceParent FROM claimed ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE domainforge_outbox SET attempts = attempts + 1, next_attempt_at = now() + make_interval(secs => #{delaySeconds}), last_error = #{error}, claimed_until = NULL, claim_token = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND claim_token = #{token}
UPDATE domainforge_outbox SET claimed_until = NULL, claim_token = NULL WHERE claim_token = #{token} AND sent_at IS NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM domainforge_outbox WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM domainforge_outbox WHERE sent_at IS NOT NULL AND sent_at < now() - make_interval(hours => #{retentionHours}) LIMIT #{limit})
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM domainforge_outbox WHERE sent_at IS NULL
